name: New Brunswick Provincial Nominee Program (NBPNP)
description: Skilled-worker streams of the New Brunswick Provincial Nominee Program (NBPNP) and whether they run through Express Entry (an Express Entry-aligned nomination adds 600 CRS points).

attributes.legal_status: in force on the access date (provincial programme under a federal–provincial agreement)

skilled_worker_streams.summary: Pathways incl. New Brunswick Experience (since 4 May 2026 limited to healthcare, education and construction occupations), Graduates and Priority Occupations
Federal Express Entry profile, 1 year full-time work for a NB employer, CLB 7, at least 67/100, age 19–55

attributes.notes: Accommodation and food services (NAICS 72) excluded since 3 February 2026. Latest Express Entry draw 17 September 2026 (102 invitations).
attributes.status_dependency: Eligibility depends on occupation (NOC/TEER), job offer, language scores and existing ties to the province — all unknown (USER-PROFILE.md; OPEN-QUESTIONS.md items 2, 4, 7).

sources.title: Express Entry Stream Guide — Employment in New Brunswick (June 2026)

verification.notes: Read through search-engine extracts of the provincial programme's official pages, not fetched in full.

limitations: Stream rules change several times a year and intake is often by invitation only; read the provincial guide in force before applying.
